def put(x,y,ch):
    i=int((x-X0)//RES); j=int((y-Y0)//RES)
    if 0<=i<W and 0<=j<H: grid[H-1-j][i]=ch
for e in ents:
    L=e['_layer']; vs=[v for v in e['_v'] if v[1] is not None]

    if L=='WALL' and e['_type']=='LWPOLYLINE':
        pts=vs
        for k in range(len(pts)-1):
            (xa,ya),(xb,yb)=pts[k],pts[k+1]
            n=max(1,int(max(abs(xb-xa),abs(yb-ya))//RES))
            for t in range(n+1):
                put(xa+(xb-xa)*t/n, ya+(yb-ya)*t/n,'#')
    if L in ('WINDOW','DOOR','FIXTURE','SECT_VIEW') and e['_type']=='LINE':

        n=max(1,int(max(abs(xb-xa),abs(yb-ya))//RES))
        ch={'WINDOW':'w','DOOR':'d','FIXTURE':'f','SECT_VIEW':'-'}[L]
        for t in range(n+1): put(xa+(xb-xa)*t/n, ya+(yb-ya)*t/n, ch)

for r in grid: print(''.join(r))
